description: Canonical request template for 888_JUDGE deliberation. Hermes sends this to APEXMax (port 3002) or arifOS MCP (port 8088).

candidate.action_description: string — concise description of proposed action
candidate.blast_radius: string — what files/services/users could be affected
candidate.rollback_plan: string — how to undo if needed

evidence.source: string — file path, URL, or tool name

context.previous_verdict: string? — prior verdict ID if this is an appeal

floors_at_risk.F13_Sovereign: bool — does Arif need to decide?

notes: string? — any extra context for APEXMax
